title: Pipeline Configuration
subtitle: Configure the agent execution sequence for this project

remove.confirm: Remove this step from the pipeline?

memory.title: Memory Mode
memory.description: Controls how much context is preserved between conversations

hint.conservative: Preserves maximum context (up to 50K tokens). Best for complex projects requiring full history.
hint.balanced: Moderate context (up to 20K tokens). Good balance between quality and cost.
hint.aggressive: Minimal context (up to 10K tokens). Fastest and cheapest. Best for simple, independent tasks.

errors.noSteps: Pipeline must have at least one step
errors.maxLLMs: A pipeline can use up to 3 different LLMs
